svg.title: Let the content bot edit posts, not your CI: a changed-files allowlist gate
svg.desc: A git diff gate: two parallel file paths (origin/BASE...HEAD) enter a narrow allowlist box; one path is blocked by a thick red slash, the other exits clean; a dashed commit arrow loops back to the box, showing the closed-fail check. Trace Bloom generative banner for “Let the content bot edit posts, not your CI: a changed-files allowlist gate”. A isometric lattice probed by 3 emitters; interference blooms mark where the wavefronts meet. Seed 790387088.
